::: {#thm-risk-difference-switch-ref}

#### Switching the reference group in a risk difference

Let:

- $\risk_1$ and $\risk_2$ be the [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1 and group 2.
- $\RD \eqdef \risk_1 - \risk_2$ be the [risk difference](#def-risk-difference) of group 1 compared with group 2, with group 2 as the [reference group](#def-reference-group).

Then the risk difference of group 2 compared with group 1, with group 1 as the reference group, is the negative of $\RD$:

$$\risk_2 - \risk_1 = -\RD.$$

:::

::: proof
This is the result of @sol-risk-difference-switch-ref.
:::
